chapter.verse: Kumpipa Lemuel, a nu in a thuhilhna:
Ka it mahmah ka ta aw, thu ngenngen-a kong neih tapa na hi hi. Bang hong gen ding ka hi hiam?
Na thatang teng numei tungah beisak kei in la, na sum khempeuh numei tungah zang kei in, numei in kumpipa siasak thei hi.
Lemuel aw, ka thugen hong ngai in. Kumpite in zu nek huai lo a, mi ukte in khamtheihzu a duh ding hi lo hi.
Zu ne le uh, thukham mangngilh uh a, thukham hei-in mizawngte gim pia kha thei uh hi.
A si dekdekte, khamtheihzu pia in la, a lungkham mahmahte, leenggahzu pia in.
Amaute ne sak lecin a zawn’na uh mangngilhin, a lungkhamna uh phawk nawn lo ding hi.
Thu a gen thei lo mite’ adingin gensak in la, a huh ding om lo mite pan’pih in.
Amau’ ading thu genin a tangin thu khen in la, a zawng-a cimawh mite, amau’ adinga kilawm hamphatna ngah sak in.
Zi hoih in suangmanpha sangin manpha zawpek a, ahi zongin zi hoih ngah ding haksa mahmah hi.
A pasal in muang mahmah a, a innsung uh ah annek kitasam ngei lo uh hi,
Amah in a khan’ tawntungin a pasal tungah thupha bawl a, a pasal tungah thusia tun’ngei lo hi.
Amah in samul leh khau zongin, thanuam takin nasem hi.
Amah in, sumbukte’ van pua teembaw bangin, gamlapi panin an hong ciahpih hi.
Phalvak tungin ziingtho a, an nek ding teng lim takin bawlin, a nasem numeite’ sep ding teng vaihawmsak hi.
Amah in leitang hoih penpen zong a, a thalawhsa sum tawh a leenggui lo ding lei hi.
A nik sing ten’in a puanban zial a, thalawp takin a na sem hi.
Amah in a nasepte a manphatna thei a, zankim zankhang dongin a meivak mit lo hi.
Amah in khau kheek-in, a puan ding gan tawm hi.
A zawng mite tungah amah cingh a, a cimawh mite tungah huhna pia hi.
A innkuan bup-un puanlum guan’ zo ahih manin, phalbi tun’ ding lunghimawh lo hi.
Amah in a puan ding khui tawm a, saihadial puansan vive silh zo hi.
A pasal, thukhen upate lakah a tut ciangin, mite’ lakah kizahtak hi.
Amah in puan khui-in, kawnggakte zong bawl a, sumbukte tungah tuate zuak hi.
Amah a tha hatin, zong kizahtak a, mailam hun-a ding a lung patau lo hi.
Amah in pilna tawh thu gen a, kam khum takin pau hiat-hiat hi.
Amah in a innkuan sung kisapna teng sem a, a tawntungin manlah den hi.
A tate in amah it uh a, a pasal in zong pakta mahmah a,
“Zi hoih tampi a om tei hangin, nang kan-a hoih kuamah om kei,” ci-in phat hi.
Ngaihban’na in zuaupi hi thei a, mel hoihna zong maimang thei hi; ahi zongin Topa a zahtak numei in a phat taak khat ahi hi.
A sepna khempeuh hangin amah phat un, mi khempeuh in a zahtak dingin a kilawm ahi hi.
